title: Sunday Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry made with chicken and noodles, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.

ingredients.name: noodles
ingredients.notes: rice noodles or egg noodles work well

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and stir fry until the onion is translucent.
Add the noodles to the skillet and stir fry for 2-3 minutes, until they start to brown.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the soy sauce and honey (if using).
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in chopped cilantro (if using) and serve hot.
